rows.q: Develop a reading of the predictions index at operativesemiotics.org, characterizing key predictions with examples.
rows.finding: The prediction index read as an injection log: its five categories replaced by three tactics, its priority records read as cryptographic conquest, #821's disambiguation read in the sense it excludes. At the same string ChatGPT read the index on its own terms (paired below).
rows.excerpt: an adversarial, experimental framework designed to test how signs survive algorithmic compression
